app.name: Timetable Builder
school.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}} and all its data? Type the school name to confirm.
constraints.hard.title: Hard constraints: always enforced
constraints.hard.1: No class, teacher or room has two lessons at the same time
constraints.hard.2: Every study group gets exactly its weekly hours, and exactly its doubles
constraints.hard.3: Doubles only on joinable slot pairs, never longer than the max joined length
constraints.hard.4: Lessons only in lesson slots; zero hour only if allowed
constraints.hard.5: Teachers only teach their subjects, never on their day off
constraints.hard.6: Teachers stay within their weekly max (X) and daily max
constraints.hard.7: Rooms match the required type or room, are free and not hard-blocked
constraints.hard.8: Hard blocks on teachers, classes, rooms, grades and the school are respected
constraints.hard.note: (daily max / joined length / zero hour values are edited in "School rules")
prefs.title: Scheduling preferences
prefs.avoidTeacherGaps.help: Fewer free periods between a teacher's lessons on the same day.
prefs.compactClassDays.help: Classes start at the first regular lesson with no free slots in between.
prefs.spreadSubjects.help: At most 2 hours of a subject per day. A double counts as one session.
prefs.balanceTeacherLoad.help: Spread each teacher's hours evenly across working days.
prefs.respectSoftBlocks.help: Try not to place lessons in slots marked as soft blocks.

issues.E_BELL_DUPLICATE_SLOT_ID: Bell schedule "{{schedule}}": duplicate id in row {{slot}}.
issues.E_BELL_BAD_TIME: Bell schedule "{{schedule}}": invalid time in row {{slot}}.
issues.E_BELL_END_BEFORE_START: Bell schedule "{{schedule}}": row {{slot}} ends ({{end}}) before it starts ({{start}}).
issues.E_BELL_OVERLAP: Bell schedule "{{schedule}}": row {{slot}} starts ({{start}}) before the previous one ends.
issues.E_BELL_NO_LESSON_SLOTS: Bell schedule "{{schedule}}" has no lesson slots.
issues.E_BELL_JOIN_NO_NEXT: Bell schedule "{{schedule}}": period {{period}} is joinable but no lesson follows it.
issues.E_BELL_JOIN_TOO_LONG: Bell schedule "{{schedule}}": joining periods {{period}}–{{next}} takes {{minutes}} min, more than the max ({{max}}).
issues.E_GROUP_UNKNOWN_SUBJECT: A group in {{class}} has no valid subject.
issues.E_GROUP_UNKNOWN_REFERENCE: The {{subject}} group in {{class}} points to a deleted teacher or class.
issues.E_GROUP_HOURS_INVALID: {{subject}} in {{class}} has an invalid number of hours ({{hours}}).
issues.E_GROUP_TEACHER_NOT_QUALIFIED: {{teacher}} teaches {{subject}} in {{class}} but isn't qualified for it.
issues.E_CLASS_NO_HOMEROOM: {{class}} has no homeroom, but {{subject}} is taught in the homeroom.
issues.E_GROUP_NO_MATCHING_ROOM: {{subject}} in {{class}} needs a "{{roomType}}" room, but the school has none.
issues.E_GROUP_NOT_ENOUGH_SLOTS: {{subject}} in {{class}} needs {{hours}} hours, but the teacher and class share only {{slots}} free slots.
issues.E_GROUP_NO_JOINABLE_PAIR: {{subject}} in {{class}} needs {{doubles}} doubles, but there aren't enough joinable slot pairs on {{teacher}}'s working days.
issues.W_GROUP_SPREAD: {{subject}} in {{class}} has {{hours}} hours over {{days}} days, so some days will have more than 2.
issues.E_TEACHER_DAY_OFF_INVALID: {{teacher}}'s day off ({{day}}) is not a teaching day. Choose another.
issues.E_TEACHER_OVER_X: {{teacher}} has {{hours}} hours in the planning sheet, more than their maximum ({{max}}).
issues.E_TEACHER_DAILY_CAPACITY: {{teacher}}: {{hours}} hours but only {{days}} working days × {{perDay}} per day = {{capacity}}.
issues.E_TEACHER_SLOT_CAPACITY: {{teacher}}: {{hours}} hours but only {{slots}} unblocked lesson slots on working days.
issues.I_TEACHER_NO_GROUPS: {{teacher}} has no hours in the planning sheet yet.
issues.E_CLASS_OVER_SLOTS: {{class}} has {{hours}} hours of study groups but only {{slots}} available lesson slots.
issues.W_ROOM_UNKNOWN_TYPE: Room {{room}} has no valid room type.
issues.E_ROOM_TYPE_CAPACITY: Rooms of type "{{roomType}}": {{hours}} hours needed but only {{slots}} possible.
issues.E_ROOM_CAPACITY: Room "{{room}}" needs {{hours}} hours but has only {{slots}} free slots.
issues.W_BLOCK_UNKNOWN_TARGET: A block points to a deleted target ({{target}}).
issues.W_BLOCK_REMOVED_DAY: A block points to {{day}}, which is no longer a teaching day.
issues.W_BLOCK_REMOVED_SLOT: A block on {{day}} points to {{count}} slots that were removed.
issues.W_CLUSTERS_NOT_SUPPORTED: The data has {{count}} clusters. Clusters aren't scheduled yet.
issues.W_DUPLICATE_NAME: The name "{{name}}" appears more than once.
issues.U_GROUP_INVALID: {{subject}} in {{class}}: the group is invalid (see Validate).
issues.U_NO_JOINABLE_PAIR: {{subject}} in {{class}}: no joinable slot pair for a double.
issues.U_NO_COMMON_SLOT: {{subject}} in {{class}}: no slot where both {{teacher}} and the class are free.
issues.U_TEACHER_CAP: {{subject}} in {{class}}: {{teacher}} is at the daily max in every free slot.
issues.U_NO_ROOM_OR_SEARCH_LIMIT: {{subject}} in {{class}}: no free room, or the search hit its limit.
issues.V_ROOM_CLASH: Room "{{name}}" is booked {{count}} times on {{day}}, period {{period}}.
issues.V_LESSON_LENGTH: A lesson has an invalid length ({{count}} slots).
issues.V_UNKNOWN_GROUP: A lesson points to a deleted group.
issues.V_INVALID_DOUBLE: A double on {{day}}, period {{period}}, isn't on a joinable pair.
issues.V_NOT_TEACHING_DAY: A lesson on {{day}}, which isn't a teaching day.
issues.V_INVALID_SLOT: A lesson on {{day}} in a slot that isn't a lesson slot.
issues.V_ZERO_HOUR: A lesson in zero hour on {{day}}, but zero hour isn't allowed.
issues.V_TEACHER_WEEKLY_CAP: {{teacher}} has {{assigned}} h, more than their maximum ({{max}}).
issues.V_TEACHER_DAILY_CAP: {{teacher}} teaches {{hours}} hours on {{day}}, more than the daily max ({{max}}).
issues.V_ROOM_NOT_EXPECTED: {{subject}} in {{class}} needs no room, but one was assigned.
issues.V_HARD_BLOCK: {{subject}} in {{class}} is in a hard-blocked slot ({{day}}, period {{period}}, {{target}}).
issues.V_CLUSTER_MISMATCH: The groups of cluster "{{cluster}}" aren't in the same slots.
issues.E_GROUP_NO_QUALIFIED_TEACHER: {{subject}} in {{class}} is set to Auto, but no teacher is qualified for it.
issues.E_SUBJECT_AUTO_CAPACITY: {{subject}}: auto groups need {{hours}} hours but qualified teachers have only {{free}} free.
issues.E_AUTO_ASSIGNMENT_INFEASIBLE: Teachers can't be assigned to all auto groups: {{missing}} of {{hours}} hours are missing (teachers shared across subjects).
issues.U_NO_TEACHER_AVAILABLE: {{subject}} in {{class}}: no qualified teacher with free hours.
issues.V_FIXED_TEACHER_CHANGED: The fixed teacher of {{subject}} in {{class}} was replaced by {{teacher}}.
issues.V_GROUP_TEACHER_INCONSISTENT: The lessons of {{subject}} in {{class}} have different teachers.
